retention.manager_action_required: Retain these four files under the canonical evidence root and record the ledger row with node scripts/i18n/ledger-assemble.mjs --locale ru --file src/i18n/catalogues/ru/ui.library.json. No ledger command was run by this auditor: ledger-assemble writes i18n/ledger.json and i18n/receipts/<instance>.json, and this task is read-only.

unverified: No production ICU parser/formatter, Electron/React run, screen reader or rendered frame: read-only, no-build, no-server, no-test-tree constraint. Grammar, register and fit judgments are native-reader reasoning over the catalogue bytes plus the measured cell counts — not runtime output, and the rail's real pixel width was not measured.

No ledger write, tracked evidence retention, PR comment or commit: this audit wrote only to its session scratchpad. ledger-assemble.mjs was deliberately not run because it writes i18n/ledger.json and i18n/receipts/<instance>.json (source lines 423,427).
The 159 legacy ui.library values were not certified; only JSON validity, key-set parity, placeholder parity, ICU completeness and cross-file term consistency were checked for them.

The translator session is unrecorded ('not supplied'), so independence is asserted from this session's own transcript (no translation work performed here), not by comparing against a named translator session.
Cross-locale calibration (fr/es/zh-CN/vi/ur/hi) was read to judge whether the Kind/Type collapse and Latin tokens are locale-wide patterns; those locales' own verdicts are their auditors'.
